name: smwmusic-mega-man-dual-override-trailer-star-mix
title: Mega Man Dual Override - Trailer (Star-mix)
description:
Honey, I turned the Mega Man Dual Overdrive Trailer Theme into a Starman theme. I know I'm late to the party with this, but I thought it'd be sick to make another Mega Man invincibility theme and it being the best thing about The Game Awards 2025 (check out my one for Mega Man 2 if you haven't already).

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C# (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. D Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. C Minor (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Skips the Intro (INTRO Disabled)
